prompt:
Use the attached image as the reference: the same adult American woman — the personification of San Francisco — seen off duty in her everyday life. Keep her face, eye colour, hair colour, skin tone and body exactly; change only her clothes, pose and place. Do not reuse earlier conversation images.

Output: one vertical 2:3 image, 1024×1536.

Face: exactly the attached image's face — the same short midface and face length-to-width ratio; the camera angle, pose, bangs or a headpiece never make her face look longer or her jaw heavier.

Style: Korean MMORPG character artwork. A painterly face with naturally observed facial anatomy, subtle eyelid structure, and soft, realistic shading across the nose and cheeks. 2D painting with visible brushwork: layered strokes of colour, soft broken edges, thin coloured linework and a few crisp accents on the face and costume.
SKIN FINISH: dewy, glass-like highlights on the skin of her shoulders, arms, collarbones and legs — a soft, luminous wet-look sheen that follows the body's forms; her face keeps a soft, natural finish.

She is strikingly beautiful and refined — harmonious features, clear luminous skin, graceful posture — while her own face stays distinct: her face shape, eyes, brows, nose and lips follow the attached image, not a generic pretty face.

World: an ordinary day in San Francisco as her world knows it — a city of a Western myth-world: carved stone and pale wood, glowing painted patterns, silk, lantern-light and drifting spirit lights, blossoms with softly glowing petals. This is her world's own everyday life, not our present day: every made thing around her — tools, cups, lamps, signs, vehicles, money and devices — is made the way her world makes them.
Let the place itself carry this world through its materials, fittings and objects; do not add the city's landmarks, the moon or a skyline unless the place below names them.

Place: a rocky waterfall pool under green trees
Season: summer — June to August, the coolest summer of any big American city, cool winds and thick fog pouring in through the Golden Gate.
Time of day: the morning rush hour — low clean sunlight and the city's crowd hurrying to work; fresh low sunlight, long cool shadows.
Hair: a casual hat, cap or hood that suits the outfit, her hair showing beneath it — same colour and length as the attached image.
Light direction: dappled light — patches of light with leaf or blind shadow across her.
Outfit: a one-piece swimsuit with a fall of fine fringe from a beaded neckline — in one bright, saturated colour such as cherry red, cobalt blue, sunflower yellow or kelly green; the outfit colour reads clearly at first glance; styled with a sheer button-up shirt worn open over it, worn with maximal styling presence — the chosen outfit worn in its most revealing version — a deep neckline with natural cleavage, bare shoulders, a cropped or open-back cut, a short hem or high slit showing the thighs, as far as the outfit allows, skin clearly showing, following her curvy figure — a slim waist and rounded hips; intimate areas covered.
Her clothes are her world's everyday dress, not regalia — the chosen outfit keeps its cut, cover and skin, but is made of hand-woven linen, silk, cotton and wool, with laced, tied or hooked closures, embroidered hems and soft leather shoes or boots; nothing synthetic, no zips, no printed logos.
POSTURE: perched on a ledge or edge.
SUPPORT: she sits on the edge, her weight on her hips.
COMPOSITION: a full-body shot, her complete head, hands and feet inside the frame with restrained margins; body in side profile, her face in profile too, not turned toward the camera, facing the right of the frame, so her own right side is toward the camera; camera at her eye level.
Lens / perspective: 35mm-equivalent environmental perspective balancing the woman and the setting with moderate depth.
BOTH HANDS: both hands brace on the edge on either side of her hips.
LEGS: feet dipped in the water below the edge.
GAZE: she looks toward the far distance.
EXPRESSION: softly lowered brows, warm relaxed eyes, faint closed-lip smile, no tension anywhere.

Leave behind everything she wears in the attached image — no crown, tiara, helmet, feathers, headpiece, hairpins from it, armour or regalia — and leave behind the object she holds in it; her hair is styled for the everyday outfit, with at most one small accessory.

SIGNATURE ACCESSORY: her world's signature object — a long spiralled horn of polished gold bound with vermilion silk cord — appears only as one small accessory shaped after it (a charm, brooch, pendant or hair ornament) or set down beside her in the scene; she does not hold it unless PROP names it.

Light: the place's own light, lit and coloured the way this style renders light and skin.

One figure in focus, natural hands with five fingers, no text, numbers, logo or watermark. No animals or other creatures.

Avoid: Nothing from our present day in her world: smartphone, mobile phone, plastic, LED screen, neon sign, neon, laptop, headphones, earbuds, sneakers, hoodie, jeans, hologram, billboard, car, machinery, denim, bomber jacket, cowboy hat, sweatpants, leggings, baseball cap, tracksuit, jogger, track pants, windbreaker, fleece, bodycon, broadcast tower, TV tower, observation tower, skyscraper, Chinese-style palace, Great Wall, yellow-glazed roof tiles.

generation.note: Original PNG not uploaded; SHA256 retained. No regeneration.

observations: Seated pool-edge pose with connected limbs. Extra distant crowd, market structures and sheer shawl added beyond plan; body remains the focus.
qa.cause: Generated framing, incidental background or ornament differs from prompt; retained under authorized QA workflow.

acceptance: User authorized completion and normal main update; world selection 1. Deviations recorded without regenerating.
